WITH enc AS (
  SELECT facid, COUNT(DISTINCT patref) AS np, SUM(missappt) AS sum_miss
  FROM encounters GROUP BY facid),
cri AS (
  SELECT e.facid, SUM(tb.crisisint) AS sum_cri
  FROM encounters e JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey GROUP BY e.facid),
adh AS (
  SELECT e.facid, SUM(CASE WHEN o.txadh IN ('High','Medium') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS tar
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes o ON o.txref = tb.txkey
  GROUP BY e.facid),
f AS (
  SELECT enc.facid AS facility_id, adh.tar AS tar,
         1.0/(1.0 + cri.sum_cri*1.0/enc.np + enc.sum_miss*1.0/enc.np) AS psm
  FROM enc JOIN cri ON cri.facid = enc.facid JOIN adh ON adh.facid = enc.facid),
med AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT AVG(tar) FROM (SELECT tar FROM f ORDER BY tar
        LIMIT 2 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f) % 2
        OFFSET (SELECT (COUNT(*)-1)/2 FROM f))) AS median_tar,
    (SELECT AVG(psm) FROM (SELECT psm FROM f ORDER BY psm
        LIMIT 2 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f) % 2
        OFFSET (SELECT (COUNT(*)-1)/2 FROM f))) AS median_psm)
SELECT f.facility_id AS facility_id,
       ROUND(f.tar, 2) AS treatment_adherence_rate,
       ROUND(f.psm, 2) AS patient_stability_metric,
       CASE WHEN f.tar >= med.median_tar AND f.psm >= med.median_psm THEN 'High Adherence, High Stability'
            WHEN f.tar >= med.median_tar AND f.psm <  med.median_psm THEN 'High Adherence, Low Stability'
            WHEN f.tar <  med.median_tar AND f.psm >= med.median_psm THEN 'Low Adherence, High Stability'
            ELSE 'Low Adherence, Low Stability' END AS performance_quadrant
FROM f, med
ORDER BY performance_quadrant, facility_id
LIMIT 100

WITH tes AS (
  SELECT e.patref AS patref, e.abref AS abref, MAX(e.timemark) AS adate,
         AVG(CASE json_extract(tb.therapy_details,'$.engagement')
                  WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
                  WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0 END) AS tes
  FROM encounters e JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey
  GROUP BY e.patref, e.abref)
SELECT e.patref AS patient_id,
       e.abref AS assessment_id,
       t.adate AS assessment_date,
       ROUND(t.tes, 2) AS avg_tes,
       f.envstress AS environmental_stress,
       f.lifeimpact AS life_impact
FROM encounters e
JOIN facilities f ON f.fackey = e.facid
JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk r ON r.asrkey = e.abref
JOIN tes t ON t.patref = e.patref AND t.abref = e.abref AND t.adate = e.timemark
WHERE (f.envstress = 'Severe' OR f.lifeimpact = 'Severe')
  AND (r.suicrisk IN ('High','Severe')
       OR json_extract(r.mental_health_scores,'$.depression.phq9_score') > 15
       OR json_extract(r.mental_health_scores,'$.anxiety.gad7_score') > 15)
  AND t.tes < 2
ORDER BY assessment_date DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH sse AS (
  SELECT e.patref AS patref,
         (CASE d.socsup WHEN 'Strong' THEN 3 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       + (CASE d.relqual WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 2 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 1 WHEN 'Conflicted' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END) AS sse,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.patref ORDER BY e.timemark DESC) AS rn
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis d ON d.asdkey = e.abref),
ma AS (
  SELECT patref, AVG(missappt) AS avg_missed FROM encounters GROUP BY patref),
stable AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.patref AS patref
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis d ON d.asdkey = e.abref
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes o ON o.txref = tb.txkey
  WHERE d.recstatus = 'Stable' AND o.funcimpv IN ('Moderate','Significant'))
SELECT s.patref AS patient_id,
       ma.avg_missed AS avg_missed_appointments,
       s.sse AS sse_score
FROM sse s
JOIN ma ON ma.patref = s.patref
JOIN stable st ON st.patref = s.patref
WHERE s.rn = 1 AND (ma.avg_missed > 2 OR s.sse < 3)

SELECT d.primdx AS diagnosis,
       COUNT(DISTINCT e.patref) AS patient_count,
       ROUND(SUM(tb.crisisint) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT e.patref), 2) AS cif
FROM encounters e
JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis d ON d.asdkey = e.abref
JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey
GROUP BY d.primdx
ORDER BY cif DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH ag AS (
  SELECT e.clinid AS clinid, COUNT(DISTINCT e.patref) AS np, SUM(e.missappt) AS sum_miss
  FROM encounters e GROUP BY e.clinid),
cr AS (
  SELECT e.clinid AS clinid, SUM(tb.crisisint) AS sum_cri
  FROM encounters e JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey GROUP BY e.clinid),
base AS (
  SELECT c.clinkey AS clinician_id, c.facconnect AS facility_id,
         1.0/(1.0 + cr.sum_cri*1.0/ag.np + ag.sum_miss*1.0/ag.np) AS psm
  FROM clinicians c
  JOIN facilities f ON f.fackey = c.facconnect
  JOIN ag ON ag.clinid = c.clinkey
  JOIN cr ON cr.clinid = c.clinkey
  WHERE CASE json_extract(f.support_and_resources,'$.community_resources')
             WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 END >= 2)
SELECT clinician_id,
       facility_id,
       ROUND(psm, 2) AS psm,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY facility_id ORDER BY psm DESC) AS facility_rank
FROM base
ORDER BY facility_id, facility_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH s AS (
  SELECT e.enckey AS enckey, e.timemark AS timemark,
         json_extract(tb.therapy_details,'$.changes') AS change_type,
         CASE json_extract(tb.therapy_details,'$.engagement')
              WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
              WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0 END AS score
  FROM encounters e JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey),
l AS (
  SELECT s.*, LAG(s.score) OVER (ORDER BY s.timemark) AS prev_score FROM s)
SELECT change_type,
       COUNT(*) AS total_occurrences,
       ROUND(AVG(prev_score), 2) AS avg_score_before,
       ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS avg_score_after,
       ROUND(AVG(score - prev_score), 2) AS avg_score_change
FROM l
GROUP BY change_type
ORDER BY total_occurrences DESC

WITH m AS (
  SELECT e.facid AS facility_id,
         AVG(CASE json_extract(tb.therapy_details,'$.engagement')
                  WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
                  WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0 END) AS tes,
         AVG(CASE o.funcimpv WHEN 'Significant' THEN 3 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Minimal' THEN 1 END)
         * (SUM(CASE WHEN o.txadh IN ('High','Medium') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*)) AS rti
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes o ON o.txref = tb.txkey
  GROUP BY e.facid)
SELECT facility_id, ROUND(tes, 2) AS avg_tes, ROUND(rti, 2) AS rti
FROM m
WHERE tes > 2.0 AND rti < 0.8
ORDER BY facility_id
LIMIT 100

WITH fac AS (
  SELECT fackey,
         CASE json_extract(support_and_resources,'$.community_resources')
              WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 END AS frai
  FROM facilities),
m AS (
  SELECT e.facid AS facid,
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.suicrisk IN ('High','Severe') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS srp,
         AVG(CASE d.funcimp WHEN 'Severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Mild' THEN 1 END) AS pfis
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk r ON r.asrkey = e.abref
  JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis d ON d.asdkey = e.abref
  GROUP BY e.facid)
SELECT m.facid AS facility_id, m.pfis AS pfis, fac.frai AS frai, m.pfis - fac.frai AS rdd
FROM m JOIN fac ON fac.fackey = m.facid
WHERE m.srp > 20
ORDER BY rdd DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH fac AS (
  SELECT fackey,
         CASE json_extract(support_and_resources,'$.community_resources')
              WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 END AS frai
  FROM facilities),
enc AS (
  SELECT facid, COUNT(DISTINCT patref) AS np, SUM(missappt) AS sum_miss
  FROM encounters GROUP BY facid),
pfis AS (
  SELECT e.facid AS facid,
         AVG(CASE d.funcimp WHEN 'Severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Mild' THEN 1 END) AS pfis
  FROM encounters e JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis d ON d.asdkey = e.abref
  GROUP BY e.facid),
tt AS (
  SELECT e.facid AS facid,
         AVG(CASE json_extract(tb.therapy_details,'$.engagement')
                  WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
                  WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0 END) AS tes,
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.txadh IN ('High','Medium') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS tar
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes o ON o.txref = tb.txkey
  GROUP BY e.facid)
SELECT enc.facid AS facility_id, ROUND(pfis.pfis - fac.frai, 2) AS rdd
FROM enc
JOIN fac ON fac.fackey = enc.facid
JOIN pfis ON pfis.facid = enc.facid
JOIN tt ON tt.facid = enc.facid
WHERE (pfis.pfis - fac.frai) > 1.0
  AND (tt.tes + tt.tar * 3) / 2.0 < 1.5
  AND enc.sum_miss * 1.0 / enc.np > 2.5
ORDER BY rdd DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH fac AS (
  SELECT fackey,
         CASE json_extract(support_and_resources,'$.community_resources')
              WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 END AS resource_score
  FROM facilities),
tar AS (
  SELECT e.facid AS facid,
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.txadh IN ('High','Medium') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS tar
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes o ON o.txref = tb.txkey
  GROUP BY e.facid),
j AS (
  SELECT fac.resource_score AS x, tar.tar AS y
  FROM fac JOIN tar ON tar.facid = fac.fackey
  WHERE tar.tar IS NOT NULL)
SELECT (SELECT AVG(resource_score) FROM fac) AS frai,
       (COUNT(*) * SUM(x*y) - SUM(x) * SUM(y))
       / (SQRT(COUNT(*) * SUM(x*x) - SUM(x) * SUM(x)) * SQRT(COUNT(*) * SUM(y*y) - SUM(y) * SUM(y))) AS craa
FROM j
